nodes.name: PtFe alloy NC synthesis
nodes.procedure: Monodisperse fcc-PtFe NCs through chemical reduction of platinum acetylacetonate (Pt(acac)2) and thermal decomposition of iron pentacarbonyl (Fe(CO)5) in the presence of oleic acid (OAc) and oleylamine (OAm).
nodes.source_text: Sun et al. synthesized monodisperse fcc-PtFe NCs through chemical reduction of platinum acetylacetonate (Pt(acac)2) and thermal decomposition of iron pentacarbonyl (Fe(CO)5) in the presence of oleic acid (OAc) and oleylamine (OAm).

nodes.name: L10-PtFe NC annealing with protection
nodes.procedure: Several approaches developed including polydopamine coating (carbonized to N-doped carbon at 700°C), C2H2 carbonization (900°C), MgO shell from Mg(acac)2 decomposition, and KCl matrix. All prevent agglomeration during L10 phase transformation.

unit_operations.name: Protective coating
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: polydopamine coating, MgO layer, or KCl matrix formation

nodes.source_text: Chung et al. reported polydopamine coating... carbonized into N-doped carbon... C2H2 carbonization at 900°C... MgO shell... KCl matrix approach.

nodes.name: L12-Pt3Co NC synthesis from MOF
nodes.procedure: Pt NCs supported on MOF-derived carbon containing atomically dispersed Co sites, annealed at 900°C. Co atoms diffuse from carbon substrate into Pt NCs forming L12-Pt3Co structure.
nodes.source_text: Wang et al. prepared L12-Pt3Co iNCs through thermal treatment of Pt NCs supported on MOF-derived carbon containing atomically dispersed Co sites.

nodes.name: PtPb/Pt nanoplates synthesis
nodes.procedure: B8₁-PtPb/Pt-core/shell nanoplates with Pt {110} facets were prepared by chemical reduction of Pt(acac)2 and Pb(acac)2 in the mixture of ODE and OAm at 160°C. Ascorbic acid (AA) was added as a weak reducing agent.
nodes.source_text: B8₁-PtPb/Pt-core/shell nanoplates with Pt {110} facets were prepared by chemical reduction of Pt(acac)2 and Pb(acac)2 in the mixture of ODE and OAm at 160°C.

nodes.name: KCl matrix Pt-M iNC synthesis
nodes.procedure: Metal salts were briefly mixed in THF. Then, potassium triethylborohydride (KEt3BH) was injected to reduce metal ions. Meanwhile, KCl formed in situ (as a byproduct) acted as a physical barrier to prevent the coalescence during annealing.
nodes.source_text: First, metal salts were briefly mixed in THF. Then, potassium triethylborohydride (KEt3BH) was injected to reduce metal ions.

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM imaging of fully ordered L10-PtFe NCs shows ordered arrangement of Fe and Pt atoms indicated by high (Pt) and low (Fe) Z contrast after 20,000 potential cycles.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The stable and ordered L10 structure of the L10-FePt NCs after 20,000 potential cycles in acid is further confirmed by high-angle annular dark-field scanning transmission electron microscopy (HAADF-STEM) imaging, in which the ordered arrangement of Fe and Pt is clearly indicated by the high (Pt) and low (Fe) Z contrast.

nodes.characterization_summary: ADF-STEM image and atomic model confirm L12 intermetallic structure in Pt3Co/C-700 NCs with periodic square array where each Co atom is surrounded by eight Pt atoms.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The L12 intermetallic structure in Pt3Co can be directly identified from atomic-resolution annular dark field-scanning transmission electron microscope (ADF-STEM) image.

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM images show ordered hcp arrangement of Pt and Pb atoms as well as PtPb/Pt core/shell structure with superlattice feature.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The ordered hcp arrangement of Pt and Pb as well as the PtPb/Pt core/shell structure is clearly presented in HAADF-STEM images.

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM reveals alternative arrangement of Pt column and Zn column in PtZn NCs identified by Z contrast and atomic model.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The inner structure of PtZn after annealing was characterized by HAADF-STEM, and the alternative arrangement of the Pt column and the Zn column was clearly identified by the Z contrast and atomic model.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD analysis confirms exclusive L12-Pt3Co structure in Pt-40Co-NC samples.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray diffraction (XRD) analysis and HAADF-STEM confirm that Pt-40Co-NC samples possess the exclusive L12-Pt3Co structure.
